content: We need to find template that when applied retrosynthetically (i.e., reverse of forward) to the given molecule (which is a TMS-protected alcohol) yields the alcohol precursor. The forward reaction: alcohol + TMSOTf + base -> TMS ether + byproducts. In retrosynthesis, we break O-Si bond and form O-H (i.e., generate alcohol). So we need template that breaks O-Si bond and forms O-H. The search tool expects lists. Let's search with functional_groups_broken maybe "aliphatic hydroxyls" broken? Actually forward reaction breaks O-H (alcohol) and forms O-Si. So retrosynthetic step breaks O-Si and forms O-H. So we set functional_groups_broken: maybe "silyl ethers"? Not sure. Let's just search by bonds broken/formed. Use bonds_broken: ["O-Si"], bonds_formed: ["O-H"]. Also maybe functional_groups_broken: ["silyl ethers"]? Not sure list. Let's try with bonds only.
